narrative.hero: Teaching machines to see from raw measurements, not images.
narrative.bio: I work on single-pixel imaging and image-free sensing: I design optical measurements and train networks that operate directly on the measurement sequence, without first reconstructing an image. A single-pixel camera illuminates a scene with structured patterns and records one value per pattern with a single detector; I study how much a machine can perceive from those values alone. The results hold where conventional approaches struggle: sparse Hadamard patterns keep imaging robust through scattering media, and image-free segmentation maintains near-constant accuracy down to 0.78% sampling. At Politecnico di Milano, I plan to work on time-domain diffuse optical tomography: 3D reconstruction inside scattering media from photon arrival times, from simulation to phantoms. My long-term aim is to enable robotic systems to infer physical parameters and interpret their surroundings directly from raw measurements, guided by physical models.
narrative.welcome: I am open to research collaborations and internships in computational imaging, image-free sensing and machine perception.

projects.title: The Lift Spectrum · Robust image-free sensing
projects.summary: Image-free sensing moves the hard problem to the 1D-to-2D lift; how adaptive that lift is determines robustness.
bullets: Showed that, without reconstruction, the 1D-to-2D lift is the design problem; mapped the lift spectrum.

Proposed STSF + TPLS: +3.2–9.9 mIoU over the prior image-free method (SPIFS); near-constant accuracy down to 0.78% sampling; up to +21.7 mIoU over clean-trained reconstruct-then-segment at 20 dB noise.
highlights: Up to +21.7 mIoU at 20 dB over clean-trained reconstruct-then-segment
+3.2–9.9 mIoU over the prior image-free method (SPIFS)
Runs on a real DMD bench without fine-tuning

projects.title: Sparse Hadamard single-pixel imaging
projects.summary: Orthogonal Hadamard patterns with tunable sparsity make single-pixel imaging robust through scattering and noise.
bullets: Introduced tunable sparsity into orthogonal Hadamard patterns: noise-robust imaging through scattering, low-order matrices that save memory, no training or post-processing.

projects.title: LDGI · Optical phased-array imaging
projects.summary: Line patterns from one-dimensional optical phased arrays break the noise symmetry that ghost-imaging denoising relies on; LDGI overcomes this limitation.
bullets: Showed that line patterns from one-dimensional optical phased arrays break the noise symmetry of ghost-imaging denoising; proposed LDGI (orders-of-magnitude gains), validated optically.
highlights: Orders-of-magnitude gain over traditional ghost imaging

platform_copy.linkedin_about_zh:
我是西安交通大学博士研究生。我的研究方向是单像素成像与免成像感知：设计光学测量方案，并训练直接处理测量序列、无需先重建图像的网络。单像素相机用一系列结构光图案照明场景，由单个探测器为每个图案记录一个数值。我关注的问题是：机器仅凭这些数值能感知多少。已有工作在传统方法难以胜任的条件下依然奏效：稀疏 Hadamard 图案可在散射介质中稳健成像；免成像分割在采样率低至 0.78% 时准确率几乎不变。在米兰理工，我计划研究时域漫射光学层析成像：利用光子到达时间重建散射介质内部的三维信息，从仿真推进到仿体实验。我的长期目标是让机器人系统在物理模型指导下，直接从原始测量中推断物理参数、理解周围环境。

欢迎计算成像、免成像感知与机器感知方向的科研合作与实习机会。
